title: Physical measures for partially hyperbolic systems with $u$-definite subbundles
summary: In this paper, we study \(C^{1+α}\) diffeomorphisms of a compact Riemannian manifold \(\mathbf{M}\) with an attracting set \(Λ\) admitting a partially hyperbolic splitting \[ T_Λ\mathbf{M} = E^u\oplus C_1\oplus\cdots\oplus C_k\oplus E^s. \] We assume that, for every ergodic Gibbs \(u\)-state supported on \(Λ\), the Lyapunov exponents along each \(C_i\) are either all positive or all negative. We prove that \(Λ\) supports finitely many ergodic hyperbolic SRB measures whose basins cover Lebesgue almost every point of its topological basin.
